We need to propose a retrosynthesis route with at least 3 reactions, using templates 1914393, 1914394, 1914395 in this order.

We have applied 1914393 to target, got two fragments: fragment A: "COc1cccc(NC(=O)c2nn[nH]c2N)c1" and fragment B: "FC1CN(Cc2ccc(CCl)cc2)C1". So first disconnection yields those two.

Now need to apply template 1914394 to each fragment? The order is fixed: 1914393 then 1914394 then 1914395. Likely we apply 1914394 to one of the fragments from previous step, then 1914395 to resulting fragments.

We tried applying 1914394 to fragment A, got no result. Apply to fragment B gave result: ("ClCCl", "FC1CN(Cc2ccccc2)C1"). So fragment B further disconnects into "ClCCl" (dichloromethane?) and "FC1CN(Cc2ccccc2)C1". Good.

Now need to apply template 1914395 to remaining fragments: we have fragment A unchanged, fragment from 1914394 step: "FC1CN(Cc2ccccc2)C1". Also we have "ClCCl". Probably apply 1914395 to "FC1CN(Cc2ccccc2)C1" to break further.

Let's get template 1914395.
